reviews.comment:
Excelente, como todas las YPF del A.C.A, una atención extraordinaria,personal super amable, buenos precios,buenos descuentos por ser socio,sanitarios en excelentes condiciones. Ubicación 10 puntos. Como uno desearía que sean todas las cosas .

(Translated by Google)
Excellent, like all YPF stations affiliated with the ACA (Automobile Club of Argentina), outstanding service, super friendly staff, good prices, great member discounts, and restrooms in excellent condition. The location is perfect. Just as one would wish everything could be.

Baños de mujeres muy sucios, no los pudimos utilizar. Los tachos llenos de papeles, desbordados por el piso, intente cerrar las puerta  y no cierran , no había papel. Decidimos seguir sin utilizar el baño. Una vergüenza

(Translated by Google)
The women's restrooms were filthy; we couldn't use them. The bins were overflowing with toilet paper, spilling onto the floor. I tried to close the doors, but they wouldn't shut, and there was no toilet paper. We decided to continue not using the restroom. It was a disgrace.
